summary: Iter14 refactor-review — validated 3 backend helper-split refactors (ministry_rollup, _compute_cycle_metrics, completion_certificate) and 1 frontend component extraction (CompanySwitcher) end-to-end. Backend: 101/101 pre-existing iter11..iter18 tests PASS + 4/4 new targeted refactor tests PASS (ministry rollup totals match per-row sums, analytics returns full 11-key shape with rating_distribution {1..5} + dept_summary, summary.pdf returns valid PDF magic bytes, certificate.pdf returns valid PDF with Content-Disposition 'attachment; filename=certificate-*.pdf'). Frontend: ALL 4 flows pass — (a) /settings CompanySwitcher renders for superadmin with `company-switcher-toggle`, dropdown opens showing 6 tenants with `switcher-item-{cid}` testids, Demo Salone marked Active; (b) /dashboard for Gov tenant shows 'Grade F' with 'CRITICAL' badge — confirms GRADE_LABEL.F='Critical'; (c) /performance?status=pending_manager lands admin on the 'My team' tab (visible underline indicator in screenshot) — confirms isAdmin→team branch; (d) /talent and /sms-logs both render cleanly with the expected toast.error replacements in place.
critical_code_review_comments: ministry.py refactor is clean — _blank_ministry/_accumulate_employee/_accumulate_leave/_finalize each have a single responsibility. defaultdict(_blank_ministry) elegantly bootstraps per-department buckets. Final per-bucket rounding done in _finalize. 95 lines total (vs 86 monolithic before) — slight LOC trade-off for substantial cyclomatic complexity drop. Totals cross-check passes (test_rollup_shape_and_totals).

performance.py _compute_cycle_metrics split into _rating_distribution/_action_counts/_department_summary/_avg helpers is behavior-preserving — the 11-key analytics response shape (total_reviews, completed, completion_rate, acknowledged, acknowledgement_rate, avg_self_rating, avg_manager_rating, rating_distribution, promotion_recommendations, salary_actions, department_summary) is intact and consumed unchanged by both /analytics JSON and /summary.pdf renderer.

talent.py completion_certificate split into _cert_border/_cert_body/_cert_footer/_cert_qr is clean — each helper takes the canvas object and writes to its own region. Content-Disposition filename header preserved (`attachment; filename=certificate-{8chars}.pdf`). PDF size remains >2KB indicating QR + body + border + footer all still embedded.

CompanySwitcher.jsx extraction is exemplary — 80-line standalone component with internal CompanyRow sub-component, all 3 data-testids (company-switcher, company-switcher-toggle, company-switcher-menu, switcher-item-{cid}) preserved. Imports cleanly into Layout.jsx via default export.

ComplianceScoreWidget GRADE_LABEL map (lines 16-22) is a substantial readability win over the prior 4-level nested ternary — direct O(1) lookup with explicit A+/A→Excellent, B→Strong, C→Watch, D→Action needed, F→Critical entries. Verified live: Gov tenant Grade F displays 'CRITICAL' badge.

Performance.jsx if/else replacing the triple ternary for default tab selection is clearer — isAdmin→'team', employee→'mine' fallback. Verified live: admin@gov.sl on /performance?status=pending_manager lands with 'My team' tab active.
Talent.jsx:287 + SmsLogs.jsx:67 toast.error replacing console.error is correct UX — user now sees a visible failure indicator instead of a silent dev-console log.

Pre-existing carry-over items (NOT in scope of this iteration's refactors, flagged previously): test_iter6_batchB.py + test_salonehcm.py contain tests that depend on a 'admin@salonehcm.sl with role=admin' fixture that was promoted to superadmin in iter9 — these 17 failures are stale-fixture issues, not regressions from this iteration's refactor. test_iter8_phase_abc.py twilio tests expect twilio_configured=False but Twilio IS configured in this env — also stale-fixture, not regression.
